relevance_note: Single case report of a NOD2 mutation carrier: 'Here we describe a sporadic BS patient with a functional NOD2 mutation'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. One in-scope person (label 'patient'). The healthy, untested parents and the 'five additional BS cases in the Japanese cohort' (ref [10], counts only, no individual detail) get no rows. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients set true from 'As described elsewhere, a 1813A>C ... mutation was discovered ... [2]': the paper implies the patient's variant and assay were reported in ref [2] but does not say explicitly that the patient was. Variant printed without 'c.' prefix as '1813A>C' and protein as 'T605P'; recorded as printed; no transcript given; zygosity and inheritance not stated ('sporadic' and 'healthy parents' are not parental testing). Age at onset recorded as 'at the age of six months, and one month later' (papules one month after BCG at six months; ISO P7M is that sum). No age at diagnosis or last evaluation stated; laboratory tests at three years. Arthritis checklist item marked observed from the Figure 1B legend 'Phalangeal joints are swelling' and the ankle joint fluid; the text calls the lesions 'painless cystic tumors', not arthritis; tenosynovitis left not reported. 'no organomegaly' recorded as excluding splenomegaly; hepatomegaly-or-hepatic-granulomas left not reported (composite item). Normal tests listed as a group (blood count, urinalysis, liver proteins, serum calcium, ANA, chest and skull X-ray, ECG, abdominal and cardiac sonograms) recorded as excluded abnormalities of each test as named; they do not exclude renal, lung or cardiac checklist items. The LAG/BerMac immunohistochemistry (to exclude Langerhans cell histiocytosis) was not recorded as a feature. No contradictions found.
